name: astril - Preprocess MRI (register/skull-strip/normalize)
desc: Stage 2 - co-register, skull-strip (HD-BET), and intensity-normalize a NIfTI library, producing an aligned, skull-stripped preprocessed library. Optionally continues an existing preprocessed library (select it in the 'Prior preprocessed library' field) -- new exams for already-known patients are registered into the SAME reference space chosen previously, never a re-picked one. QC PDFs are an optional extra output. Versions: astril-nf 0.1.0, astril 0.7.30.
